parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with printed maps or text.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface of the globe, showing geographical information and rotating around its axis for educational or decorative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting base and frame of the globe, typically made of metal to provide stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the spherical globe in place, allowing it to rotate smoothly while maintaining balance on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a pivot axis for the rotating sphere.
